quotes.text: This volunteer model is not governance. It's neglect with a name tag. A product requires dedicated ownership. Someone whose job includes keeping the product healthy, not as an afterthought.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sharp verdict on volunteer site ownership and the case for product-style ownership of the intranet.

quotes.text: If your permissions are messy, AI can't safely retrieve information. Graph doesn't fix these problems. It makes them visible to systems that can. And that visibility is the first step toward automated optimization.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why Microsoft Graph readiness is the foundation for any AI-driven intranet.

quotes.text: Rage clicks are one of the most diagnostic signals clarity provides. A rage click is when a user clicks the same element multiple times in rapid succession. It means they think something is broken.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear definition of a key behavioral signal that page views never capture.

quotes.text: Search is the most underutilized source of insight in most sharepoint environments. And that's strange because it's also the most honest.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes search logs as the most honest signal of user intent.

quotes.text: A mediocre AI on a clean foundation will outperform a state of the art AI on a messy foundation every time. The algorithm can only see what the data reveals.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable argument that data quality matters more than AI sophistication.

takeaways: Page views measure popularity, not usefulness; real intranet quality only shows up in behavioral signals like scroll depth, failed searches and rage clicks.
Combining Microsoft Graph, SharePoint analytics, search logs and Microsoft Clarity turns isolated symptoms into a diagnosis and enables a continuous optimization loop.
AI can analyze, generate and optimize SharePoint pages, but only on clean metadata and information architecture and with human approval, sensitivity labels and governance in place.
hook: Most SharePoint intranets look successful on paper while quietly failing the employees who use them. This episode is for intranet owners, SharePoint architects and digital workplace leads who want to replace page-view vanity metrics with real telemetry. Learn how Graph, search data, Microsoft Clarity and Knowledge Agent turn a static intranet into a self-optimizing experience platform.
